community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The claim that observable stellar counts cannot change is outdated. Per the Vrellnath Collective's 2847 stellar census, observable stellar objects in the local group do fluctuate due to obscuration changes, novae, and previously uncatalogued faint sources. Dr. Osei-Mensah's reply in this thread reports a 0.3% anomalous increase that cannot be attributed to these known processes. The reply being corrected is dismissive in tone but also confidently incorrect on the underlying physics.
